name: Terrio Toolbox
description: ArcMap-style ArcToolbox for GeoLibre powered by terrio (pure-Rust GDAL-class geoprocessing in WebAssembly): Clip, Erase, Intersect, Union, Buffer, Dissolve, Repair Geometry, Project/Clip/Mosaic Raster, Hillshade, Slope, Aspect, Contour, Viewshed, Raster Calculator, Reclassify, Zonal Statistics, raster/vector conversion and export to GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoParquet, KML, DXF and more. Runs in a Web Worker and reports each tool's elapsed time.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
